target.title: Unhandled promise rejection during graceful shutdown with keep-alive connections
target.body:
When calling server.close() while clients maintain active keep-alive HTTP/1.1 connections, Node throws an unhandled rejection in the connection pool handler.

Error: Connection reset by peer at Socket.onSocketClose

candidate.title: Graceful shutdown fails when keep-alive HTTP client stays connected
candidate.body: When sending SIGINT to the server process while an open HTTP client connection has keepalive enabled, the server aborts abruptly with Connection reset by peer instead of closing cleanly.
candidate.author: user2

target.title: Memory leak in WebSocket heartbeat interval timer
target.body: The heartbeat ping interval continues running even after socket disconnects, preventing garbage collection of the client session object and leaking 15MB/hour under load.
